
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
extract_cicero <- function(dateipfad) {
  dateipfad |>
    map(read_csv) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    filter(
      Author == "Cicero",
      str_starts(Title, "Letters To|Epistulae Ad")
    )
}

```

```{r}
extract_cicero(list.files("data/Namensfunde", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))
```
